title: The crowd law in 3D
learning_goal: See the 3D version of the crowd-loss experiment as a bet with an adapted criterion, its control run, its missing spread metric, and the question of where to impose it.
takeaway: The crowd loss must be tested again in 3D, against a control run, without narrowing the dissipation, and only where the runs have settled.
notes: Extension module, extended cut only, inserted after 10.7 (before 10.9-bridge; CONTRACT P1). One scene, X3.5, PENDING (needs the fm3d model of 10.7, a fine-tune with the crowd loss, a control run with weight 0, and two evaluations). No question card: the decision it raises (where to impose the law, given runs that may still grow near the threshold) is the seat's ASK; ch07.Q (which budgets, must the spread match) and X3a.Q (fallback if the crowd loss fails) already cover the neighbouring decisions. Register NIGHT. Modules are asides: no chapter card; module tag lower-third and rail at L5 in the 0.8-s lead-in. CHANGES AGAINST THE OUTLINE, to review. (1) target 25 -> 40 s (result 35 -> 40 s): anchor, bet, criterion (three parts), confidence with its reason and the ask do not fit in 25 s (about 54 words). Module 0:25 -> 0:40. (2) The 2D anchor uses the energy-budget residual (6.1 % with the loss vs 46 % for the control, R:956-957), not the distribution distance of 08.5: it is the quantity of the bet, and it shows honestly that the 2D result itself sits just above the 5 % bar (T:903 says 'E2 reaches 6.1 %'). (3) Criterion wording follows A9: 'adapted from the tier-1 criteria; the plan sets none for 3D'; the converter's rule is applied as written (residual < 5 % at every scored point, control residual larger, spread in [0.8, 1.2]). (4) Saturated runs only (A8) is a chip and the subject of the ASK. SYMBOLS: ε dissipation and P injection (as 08.5, 10.3; here P = ⟨f·u⟩ varies per snapshot), σ(ε) for the spread (never σ(D)), β the loss weight on the formula layer (as 08.5; X3a flagged the clash with the tilt multipliers), 'budget error' in narration, 'relative budget error' on screen; no 'eta' in narration. REQUESTS (foundation engineer B, tools/data_cloud.py conv_fm3d_stat). (a) The tier-1 criterion (b) applies at parameters WITHOUT data; the converter tests every scored point: restrict the budget lamp to the held-out points (validation Re 100, Pm 1; test Re 50, Pm 2, train_fm3d.yaml:35-39) or report both, and mark training points; (b) carry the reference data's own residual per point (residual_ref): with 40 snapshots per run the data may miss 5 % themselves; (c) carry the saturation flag of palier2_tg3d.json per point and exclude non-saturated points (A8); (d) numeric worst_residual_percent (so the assembler speaks it) and the booleans met / not_met / inconclusive; (e) the spread lamp needs std_diss_rel in milady.eval (C:166): until then the verdict is 'inconclusive' even when the budget and control lamps pass, which the result narration says. LEXICON: none new. MUSIC: none (L5). PACE: 125-130 effective words per minute of target_s; assembler formula for the estimate.

sentences.text: Now the crowd law in three dimensions: energy in equals energy out, on average.
In two dimensions, the crowd loss cut the budget error to six percent; a control run of equal length stayed at forty-six.
The bet: under five percent at held-out settings, the control higher, the dissipation's spread within a fifth.
Confidence: low. In the three-variable test, this loss narrowed the budget's spread, and failed from a poor start.
Ask first: impose it near the threshold, where runs may still be growing?

sentences.text: The crowd law in three dimensions, now with real runners.
Each lane shows the budget error at every scored setting, with the loss, and with a control run of equal length.
Worst budget error with the loss, in percent: {{worst_residual_percent}}.
Budget held, control worse, spread kept: the crowd law carries over to three dimensions, at this scale.
A lamp is red: as it stands, the loss does not carry over, and that lamp says which part failed.
A lamp stays grey, most likely the dissipation's spread, which the three-dimensional evaluation does not compute yet.
One seed, forty snapshots per run, saturated runs only: indicative, not a verdict on the method.
